sentences.text:
Masook Ali S/O Yakub Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy.
Home Lko. on 16 January, 2024

Author: Pankaj Bhatia
Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:4424
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8201 of 2022
Applicant :- Masook Ali S/O Yakub Ali

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla,Ashwani Kumar Dwivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant and other accused has helped in enticing the daughter of the informant, subsequently in the recovery memo, it was found that that the victim was carrying her mark-sheet, although in the statements recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. allegation of rape was made, however, the same was not corroborated in the medical report.
As per the medical report, the age of the victim is 18 years.

The counsel for the applicant has also filed the copy of order-sheet indicating that the victim has not come forward for deposition and in fact directions for bailable warrant has been Masook Ali S/O Yakub Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Masook Ali S/O Yakub Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193506115/
1 issued against the victim on 27.09.2023.
From the order sheet placed on record, it is clear that the victim has not come forward for deposition.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 31.03.2021.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

4. Considering the non cooperation of the victim in the trial coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 31.03.2021 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Masook Ali be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.147 of 2021, under Sections 366, 506, 376 IPC, Police Station Sandila, District Hardoi, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Arun  Masook Ali S/O Yakub Ali vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
